==Description==
'''Logbooks''' are books randomly dropped from enemies upon their death. For enemies that have death animations, it is not required to wait until their death animation ends. Once collected, the enemy will be added to the [[Index]], where its model, animation, default health, default speed and description, if it has any, will be displayed. The books stay on the ground and do not disappear.

The chance of a '''Logbook''' dropping is a range of 0.9% to 15%, which increases with enemy health. The range starts at 1 health, where enemies have a 0.9% chance to drop a '''Logbook''', and ends at 100,000 health, where enemies have a 15% chance to drop a '''Logbook'''. Health past 100,000 has no effect on the chance. If a '''Logbook''' has not appeared in 60 enemy kills, the '''Logbook''' for that enemy will be forced to spawn, regardless of chance<ref>If there is an update which changes the amount of kills required for a guaranteed '''Logbook''' drop, all enemy kills are reset for that update. For example, when [[v1.52.0]] updated the amount of enemy kills for a guaranteed '''Logbook''' from 20 to 60, all enemy kills were reset.</ref>. Chance of a '''Logbook''' being dropped can be boosted with the Scholar [[Skills|Skill]], though only if it is active. Therefore, any mode that disables [[Skills]], like the [[Tutorial]] will not have this boost applied.

It does not matter what player killed or damaged the enemy, as kills from any player can generate '''Logbooks'''. Furthermore, if an enemy reaches the end of the map (or damages the outpost barrier health in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]]) and does not result in a lost match, that would count as a kill that can generate a '''Logbook'''. Additionally, all kills in [[PVP Test]] do not contribute towards '''Logbooks''' either.

Enemies that have a second phase which changes the display name of the enemy are counted as the same enemy for '''Logbooks'''. This includes the [[Awakened Fallen King]] (which is the second phase of the [[Fallen King]]), the [[Abomination|Reanimated]] (which is the second phase of the [[Abomination]]) and the [[Splitter|Lower Body]] (which is the second phase of the [[Splitter]], but the [[Split]] is a unique enemy).

==Sandbox Unlocks==
Once obtained, players are allowed to spawn in the said enemy inside of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, including enemies which are normally not able to be summoned there, even with the Admin Mode.

If an enemy '''Logbook''' shares an exact internal name with a legacy or modern counterpart, then both enemies will be available to spawn into [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though legacy enemies require the use of Admin Mode. For example, collecting the [[Frost Spirit]] '''Logbook''' from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] would allow you to spawn the [[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]] from the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. However, collecting the [[Ducky D00M III]] '''Logbook''' does not allow you to spawn the [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]] [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|variants]] from the [[Spring 2020 Event]] or [[Duck Hunt Event]] as it does not share an exact name to those enemies. Some enemies may have the same display name as removed enemies, however, due to them having a different internal name they will not unlock that enemy. For example, the [[Knight]] from [[Pizza Party]] will not unlock the [[Knight (Solar Eclipse)|Knight]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], as the one from [[Pizza Party]] is internally called ''Knight Plush'' and not just ''Knight''.

Enemies that have been removed from the game or replaced by another enemy cannot be sent, even if they share the same internal name. For example, collecting the [[Brute]] '''Logbook''' will not unlock the [[Brute (The Heights)|Brute]] from [[SFOTH Event]], as it has been removed from the game. Similarly, unlocking the [[Frost Hero]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] only unlock the [[Frost Invasion Event]], not any of the older versions.

==Trivia==
*Every '''Logbook''' displays a different enemy as the image, however the '''Logbook's''' model itself will never change.
*Due to a glitch, before the [[v1.47.0]] update, each '''Logbook''' would show a {{Gem|Gem}} icon instead of a '''Logbook''' icon when picked up. A '''Logbook''' did not reward players with {{Gem|Gems}}, duplicate or otherwise. The correct icon now displays for picked up '''Logbooks'''.
*The '''Logbook''' is heavily inspired by ''Risk of Rain 2's'' own [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vmY_4G6rcx8 Logbook] as the UI and the method of getting it is very similar.
*It is not possible to get duplicate '''Logbooks''' through normal means.
**Due to a glitch, collecting a new '''Logbook''' that the player did not have prior during the course of a match, for that match alone will allow them to get duplicate '''Logbooks''' of enemies that they already have in their [[Index]]. These collected duplicate '''Logbooks''' grant no further benefits.
